members.name: key
members.doc: Stable identity, such as an ISO date. A bar whose key survives a data change keeps its place, so switching ranges morphs instead of redrawing.

members.name: label
members.doc: Full label for the headline and screen readers, such as "Tue, Sep 15".

members.name: axisLabel
members.doc: Short label under the bar, such as "T" or "Sep 14". Leave it out to keep the axis quiet.

types.name: BarChartProps
types.doc: Use a bar chart for one measure across a run of days, weeks, or months, when people compare each period against the rest and against the average.

members.name: label
members.doc: What is measured, such as "Active minutes". Names the chart for assistive technology.

members.name: period
members.doc: The range on show, such as "Sep 15–21, 2026". It rests under the headline.

members.name: unit
members.doc: Unit after each value, such as "min".

members.name: averageLabel
members.doc: Headline label at rest, above the average.

members.name: valueLabel
members.doc: Headline label while a bar is scrubbed.

members.name: categoryLabel
members.doc: Header of the first column in the data table read by screen readers.

members.name: showAverage
members.doc: Draws the average as a reference line that springs to each new range.
